blog_suggestion.title: Why Enterprise AI Transformation Requires More Than a Partner Network
blog_suggestion.angle: SAS argues that SI-led AI decisioning rollouts without embedded governance and explainability create hidden regulatory and operational risk.
blog_suggestion.why_now: The Coforge-Pega partnership announcement puts SI-driven enterprise AI transformation in the spotlight, making this a timely governance credibility play for SAS.

competitors.name: Provenir

changes.what_changed: Provenir announced Marginalen Bank's live migration to its Cloud2 platform, signaling a validated cloud-native decisioning deployment at a regulated European bank; the 'Cloud2' branding appears to be a new or newly promoted product tier emphasizing cloud-native architecture and decisioning automation.

tab2_top_3_things_to_know: Marginalen Bank (Stockholm) has gone live on Provenir Cloud2, providing a marquee Nordic reference customer for cloud-native decisioning.
The 'Cloud2' platform label signals Provenir is actively positioning its offering as a next-generation, cloud-native migration path for banks modernizing legacy decisioning stacks.
Trade press coverage in FF News and FinTech Futures amplifies the win across European fintech audiences, increasing Provenir's competitive visibility in regulated banking.
new_product_claims: Cloud2 enables decisioning automation at scale for regulated banks via a fully cloud-native architecture.

sales_impact.what_to_attack: SAS Intelligent Decisioning offers superior governance, explainability, and audit trails required by regulators—capabilities Provenir Cloud2 has not demonstrated at enterprise depth.
sales_impact.what_to_defend: Be prepared for Provenir to use the Marginalen Bank win as proof that cloud-native decisioning migration is fast and low-risk, challenging SAS on deployment speed and agility.
sales_impact.trap_question: How does Provenir Cloud2 support model risk management, full decision lineage, and regulatory explainability audits across all decisioning flows in a Tier 1 bank environment?

blog_suggestion.title: Cloud-Native Decisioning Is Not Enough: Why Governed Intelligence Wins in Regulated Banking
blog_suggestion.angle: Migrating to the cloud solves infrastructure agility, but without embedded governance, explainability, and traceable AI, banks trade one risk for another.
blog_suggestion.why_now: A high-profile Nordic bank cloud migration win is shifting buyer conversations toward cloud-native decisioning, making it urgent to reframe the debate around governance and regulatory trust.
